name: Persado
tagline: Persado is an AI platform that uses machine learning to optimise the specific words, phrases, and emotional triggers in marketing communications — emails, push notifications, ads — to maximise engagement. Its models are trained on billions of consumer responses and can predict which language variant will perform best for a given audience segment. Enterprise brands in retail, banking, and travel use Persado to lift conversion rates on campaigns at scale.
